info.name: Grocery API
info.description:
Complete REST API for the Grocery Flutter app — every endpoint, with realistic bodies.

**How to use**
1. Start the server (`npm run start:dev`). `baseUrl` defaults to `http://localhost:3456/api/v1`.
2. Run folders top-to-bottom (or the whole collection in the Collection Runner). Tokens and IDs are saved automatically into collection variables.
3. For upload requests, select any JPEG/PNG file (a sample is in `docs/postman/sample-image.png`).

**Tokens:** `{{token}}` (customer), `{{admin_token}}`, `{{delivery_token}}` — set by the login/register requests.

**Dev accounts:** admin@grocery.test / Admin@12345 · customer@grocery.test / Customer@123 · delivery@grocery.test / Delivery@123

Success: `{ success: true, message, data }` · Error: `{ success: false, message, code, errors }` · See docs/API.md and docs/ERRORS.md.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description:
Register a fresh customer (so the run is repeatable), log in, verify email with OTP.

The token is saved automatically into `{{token}}`.

request.description:
Log in with email **or** phone + password.

Body: `email` or `phone` (one required), `password` (required), `device_name` (optional).

exec: try { const v = res.data.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('token', v); } catch (e) {}

response.name: 200 OK
